package config

import "testing"

func TestValidateRejectsEnabledOnboardingTurnWithoutTeacherToken(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.TeacherOnboardingTurnV2Enabled = true
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("enabled onboarding turn requires Teacher token")
	}
	cfg.TeacherInternalToken = "teacher-token"
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("dedicated Teacher token should permit the disabled-by-default capability: %v", err)
	}
}
